name: Ghost KillerS
source:
On his way home from school, Icchi got hit by a truck. But instead getting isekai'd, scary, strange people force him into becoming a hitman for ghosts.

Though he is dissatisfied, with no memory and no place to belong, he decides to take the job.

And so begins Icchi's new daily routine of killing people dead people.
